review_scope: Read-only independent review of the frozen PR75 Graphify/KG receipt, separate dated corpora snapshots, preservation evidence, and publication metadata.

publication_binding.post_freeze_source_diff: Checklist metadata/document update only; no source, test, or runtime artifact change observed.

reviewer_checks: Compared all 46 selected source paths against the frozen commit and receipt candidate hashes.
Independently recomputed graph counts and deltas from the maintained graph files and compared dated snapshot hashes.
Checked graph node/edge integrity for duplicate identifiers, absent endpoints, self loops, and duplicate undirected relation edges.
Compared preserved snapshot, rollback, wiki, and prior evidence hashes to their immutable backups.
Checked publication metadata receipt bindings and PR head/base/state against the recorded frozen state.
limitations: KLAPS50 and Cloud-BAL are overlapping corpora and their counts are reported separately.
Graphify extraction is structural: Markdown headings only; semantic Markdown extraction was not performed; cross-file Fortran CALL extraction is partial.
External native WRF research trees were not extracted; only selected repository patch/evidence paths are represented.
Graph freshness and integrity establish navigation evidence only; they do not establish runtime or scientific validity.
No tests or runtime validation were rerun as part of this read-only KG review; source/runtime receipts remain separately scoped, with physical approval FAIL_OPEN and native candidate REJECTED.
